ability.name: Diamond Aura
ability.note: If this Pokémon is on the field, your Fairy-type Pokémon that are not affected by a special condition are not knocked out either by Attack damage from Dragon-type Pokémon or by knockout-causing effects from Dark-type Pokémon.

wheel.name: Moon Veil
wheel.note: This Pokémon moves to a point 2 steps away. However, if the battle opponent is a Steel-type Pokémon, this Attack becomes a Miss.

wheel.name: Trick Room
wheel.note: For 5 turns, the Gold Attacks of all Pokémon become Misses, the MP of Pokémon that have MP 3 or higher become 1, and the MP of Pokémon that have MP 1 or lower becomes 3 (MP-Increasing or MP-decreasing effects from markers are applied after this).

wheel.name: Moon Veil
wheel.note: This Pokémon moves to a point 2 steps away. However, if the battle opponent is a Steel-type Pokémon, this Attack becomes a Miss.

wheel.name: Diamond Storm
wheel.note: *All opposing Flying-type Pokémon on the field spin. Those that spin a Miss or a White Attack of 80 damage or less are knocked out.
